name: pauls-running-activity
description: Read and analyse completed activities, manage structured workouts and plans, schedule calendar items, and publish eligible workouts through Intervals.icu from Paul’s Running.

interface.shortDescription: Activity analysis and protected training-plan delivery
interface.longDescription: Read completed activities and sample-level telemetry from Paul’s Running. Create validated workouts and plans, schedule them on the canonical calendar, and explicitly publish eligible calendar items through Intervals.icu for Garmin delivery.
interface.defaultPrompt: Review my recent running and help manage my Paul’s Running training calendar.
